install_note: pipx install goose-ai installs an unrelated PyPI package (goose-ai 0.1.0). The official CLI is a binary installed by the release script into ~/.local/bin/goose.
provider_note: No real LLM credentials were used. The OpenAI-compatible endpoint was a local SSE stub. The stub returned a `shell` tool call so goose would emit session/request_permission.
caveats: session/new without GOOSE_PROVIDER returns JSON-RPC error -32603: 'Failed to resolve provider and model: Configuration value not found: GOOSE_PROVIDER'.
In auto mode goose executes tools without session/request_permission. approve mode is required to observe it.
The capture is 27 KB because session/new lists the full provider and skill catalogs. Raw captures are gitignored.
